text.content:
• 1am session: Telegram empty, To-Do board dry (both open items — pose tracking, shuttle auto-detect — re-confirmed blocked on real camera/court, no new tooling)
• Code audit per Step 2b: chat page, antiCheat.ts, matchDispute.ts, OnboardingModal reviewed — all clean, no new bugs found
• 💡 Step 2c: reviewed growth/sharing surface (QR share, Invite, match-recap share, season-recap share, OG banner) — already comprehensive, no new idea cleared the concrete/scoped bar, logged only rather than force one
• No code changes this session, nothing to deploy
• 5am session: audited clubLadder.ts, clubRivalry.ts, events page, tournaments bracket rendering — all clean. Verified 3 bare-href Links (chat/clubs/rankings) are NOT bugs (next/link auto-prepends basePath)
• Found & fixed real bug: LogMatchModal capped score entry at 3 games, silently truncating bestOf-5 live matches that went 4-5 games. Bumped cap to 5, build clean, deployed (commit f890f8c)
• 9am session: Telegram empty, board still dry (same two items, same blocker). Audited bracketGen.ts, pausedMatch.ts, seasons.ts, rallyStats.ts, achievements.ts, push.ts, ChallengeModal.tsx — all clean
• Found & fixed real bug: VenueInput suggestion dropdown duplicated the whole venue name when it had no comma (custom-typed venue, e.g. "My Local Court") instead of showing nothing after the name. Build clean, deployed (commit a04fdf3)
